blocks.text: On the second of Ashley's questions, if the company has used the name at all, please send us the records themselves, not a summary of them: packaging, invoices, price lists, web pages, trade show material, or anything else that shows the name in use, together with the date on which each item was first used or published. If {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} has earlier rights in the name, how strong they are will depend on what those records show, and a date that rests on recollection alone is difficult to rely on if it is ever challenged.

Until we have given you our written view, I would also ask that the company not commit to printed packaging, signage, or a public announcement under the name. None of those steps would be decisive on its own, but each one adds to the cost of changing course if the review turns up a mark that we cannot advise you to proceed against.
If a short call would be easier than putting all of this in writing, please tell Kelly which days this week suit you, and she will set one up.
